instagram.caption:
Saturn would float in a bathtub. A really, really big one 🪐

Saturn has about 95 times Earth's mass but more than 750 times its volume, so its average density is about 0.69 g/cm³, below water's 1.0. NASA notes it's the only planet less dense than water. It is mostly hydrogen and helium, and it spins once every 10 hours 33 minutes, bulging at the equator. The bathtub is a figure of speech: a gas giant has no surface to float on.

Follow for more space facts that sound made up.

#space #saturn #astronomy #science #planets
